image_description: A close-up photograph of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The chiton has an elongated oval shape with eight overlapping calcareous plates (valves) arranged in a linear series from anterior to posterior. The plates show a mottled pattern with brown, orange, and green coloration, and have textured surfaces with growth lines. The plates are embedded in a tough leathery girdle (mantle) that appears dark with some orange spots. The chiton is surrounded by wet rocks with some pinkish coralline algae visible.
